title: RPG Maker MV keeps crashing on me; what gives?

posts.author: OfficerBoles
posts.body:
I'm a total beginner! I got MV on Steam a while ago while it was on sale, started playing around with it because I want to try making a game of my own. Starting small, of course, so I tried the built-in map tutorial, but it crashes when it gets to linking maps to tiles. I tried repeating this process on my own and got slightly further, but still it crashes once I start linking. I tried uninstalling, shutting down, starting up and reinstalling, running in compatibility mode for Windows 7, but no luck. What's going on here?
I'm using Windows 11 Pro, 32 GB of RAM
This is what it looks like up to when it crashes:

posts.body:

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
From the 4GB patch thread that SGHarlekin linked also brought up an investigation.
You are not the first - and likely won't be the last - person to complain about unexplainable crashes in MV.
While the results are inconclusive, it seems to likely stem from a Windows 11 update. Some more investigation might be needed on the topic, but that's where we landed.
My recommended course of action would be to apply the 4Gb patch to see if that resolves your problem.
If not, report back.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
That's why I recommended checking the RAM usage via task manager. The usage should rise with everything you open from animations to maps to events and not go back down again.
The patch tool does not fix this problem, but rather delays the inevitable crash. If it goes back down, it would likely be unrelated.

posts.author: Tinkerer
posts.body: I have a similar issue. And it's been getting worse over time. It started by the MV editor sometimes crashing during saving. Usually after having worked/viewing several maps between saves. At the moment it crashes about 90% of the time when I try to save or press the apply button (and I keep my edits to a minimum between saves). And every 4-5 crashes after saving it will completely wipe out my commonevents.json file (it is reduced to 0 bytes). As of yesterday the editor will also crash even when I don't do anything, the screen will start flashing white and the editor will close. I ave a Ryzen 7 5800X, RTX 3090 and 64GB of RAM. I'm also on Windows 11, but had crashing issues to a lesser degree earlier on Win10 too (which is partly why moved to Win11). Do note my commonevents.json consists of approximately 1800 events and is 10.8MB in size. I have yet to try the 4GB patch.

posts.author: Tinkerer
posts.body:
Well, I applied the 4GB patch and I have since managed to save at least 8 times in a row without crashing and I've jumped back and forth between maps, variable-, character, switchlists and scripted a few more common events. The Editor will still occasionally flash white while Idle, but has yet to crash. Memory usage does still continue to creep up, but I can live with an occasional restart
.

posts.author: Tinkerer
posts.body: Oh, I also freed up more diskspace on the drive I have RPG Maker installed on (D:\). It was down to 26GB, now it is at 77GB. Probably not related, but I thought I'd mention it just in case it uses the drive for a swap drive/memory.
